mfa_factors_totp_secret_check.name: mfa_factors_totp_secret_check
mfa_factors_totp_secret_check.value:
("idoc"."mfa_factors"."factor_type" = 'totp' and "idoc"."mfa_factors"."encrypted_secret" is not null and "idoc"."mfa_factors"."encryption_key_id" is not null) or
        ("idoc"."mfa_factors"."factor_type" = 'webauthn' and "idoc"."mfa_factors"."encrypted_secret" is null and "idoc"."mfa_factors"."encryption_key_id" is null)

payments_evidence_check.name: payments_evidence_check
payments_evidence_check.value:
("idoc"."payments"."source" in ('stripe_recurring', 'stripe_one_time') and "idoc"."payments"."external_payment_id" is not null)
      or ("idoc"."payments"."source" in ('paypal', 'bank_transfer', 'cash', 'complimentary') and "idoc"."payments"."administrator_id" is not null)
